name: TRON Lightcycle / Run

attributes.description: A high-speed launch coaster where riders straddle motorcycle-style Lightcycles and race through a neon-lit digital world inspired by the TRON films; it carries the tallest height requirement of any Magic Kingdom attraction.

needs_verification: Disney's own attraction page (disneyworld.disney.go.com/attractions/magic-kingdom/tron-lightcycle-run/) returned truncated content during this research pass and could not be fetched directly to confirm the 48in height figure verbatim on Disney's own wording — figure is corroborated by planDisney (official Q&A forum) and multiple fan sites, but a direct re-check of the main attraction page is recommended.
Ride vehicle also offers a standing 'back row' option per some fan sources — worth confirming whether this affects the accessibility/attributes model.
